name: backlog #588: the 0-based SHARD_INDEX is read as 1-based, so every log is attributed to the shard after its own
expect: the real excerpt parses: shard 5 of 38 (SHARD_INDEX 4 is 0-based), 9 progress lines, an OK verdict

name: backlog #588: the runner's fractional seconds are dropped, so a sub-second suite costs 0 or 1 s
edits: return t + (float("0." + frac) if frac else 0.0)
expect: ...with the runner's 7-digit fractional seconds kept (control 1 -> control 2 is 9.887793 s)

name: backlog #588: a mutation line's NAME is not checked, so a log is averaged in under the wrong attribution
edits: if (done, tot) != (j - n + 1, k) or not mu["name"].startswith(label.rstrip("…")):
expect: ⛔ a wrong NAME at a mutation line is refused (the `…`-cut label is a prefix of the right one only)

name: backlog #588: the progress-line COUNT is not checked, so a shard that held more than it ran is read
expect: ⛔ a wrong COUNT (the shard held one more mutation than the log ran) is refused

name: backlog #588: a control line's TARGET is not checked
expect: ⛔ a wrong TARGET order (the shard's targets are not the controls the log ran) is refused

name: backlog #588: a re-control line's TARGET is not checked
expect: ⛔ ...and a re-control naming another target is refused

name: backlog #588: a PR's DIFF-SCOPED shard is read as the full partition
edits: if "DIFF-SCOPED" in verdict or "ONLY" in verdict:
expect: ⛔ a DIFF-SCOPED (PR) run is refused: its shards are not the full partition

name: backlog #588: an unfinished shard (NOT MEASURED) is read, so a budget stop's truncated tail is costed
expect: ⛔ an unfinished shard (NOT MEASURED) is refused

name: backlog #588: a verdict naming another shard than the env block is accepted
expect: ⛔ a verdict naming another shard than the env block is refused

name: backlog #588: control is the MEAN, so one cold runner's first suite skews the target
expect: ⭐ control and re-control are MEDIANS, per-mutation the MEAN; a partial target is left to the defaults

name: backlog #588: per-mutation is the MEDIAN, which a partition summing the costs underestimates
expect: ⭐ control and re-control are MEDIANS, per-mutation the MEAN; a partial target is left to the defaults

name: backlog #588: the default fixed cost counts the control only
expect: ...the defaults are the median mutation cost and the median control + re-control

name: backlog #588: nothing to tabulate is written as an empty table
edits: if not targets or not allmut:
expect: ⛔ nothing to tabulate is refused, not written as an empty table
